overview.name: T S FLOUR MILL PUBLIC COMPANY LIMITED

profile.name: T S FLOUR MILL PUBLIC COMPANY LIMITED
profile.businessType: The Company produces and distributes wheat flour which is divided into particular types as follows: Fresh Egg Noodle, Bread Flour, Instant Noodle Flour, Biscuit Flour, All-Purpose Flour and Animal Feed Flour under its own brand. The Company was spun off from TSTE.
profile.address: 90/9 Moo 1 Poochaosamingphrai Rd., Phrapradaeng Samut Prakarn 10130
profile.dividendPolicy: The Company has a policy to pay dividends to shareholders at a rate of not less than 50 percent of net profit after deducting corporate income tax of the specific financial statements and after deducting legal reserves and other accumulated funds as determined by the Company.
profile.auditChoice: Qualified opinion with an emphasis of matters

managements.position: The person taking the highest responsibility in finance and accounting
